name: Heartland Solar Solutions
old_description: It’s not just a trend. Solar roofing is here to stay! Why? Solar roofing combines functionality and sustainability, transforming your roof into an energy-producing asset. With state-of-the-art solar technology seamlessly integrated into your home’s design, you’ll enjoy lower energy bills and a reduced carbon footprint. It’s a smart, eco-friendly investment that adds value to your property while contributing to a greener future.
about:
Heartland Roofing, Siding and Windows, LLC operates from Clive, Iowa, serving residential and commercial customers across Iowa and Minnesota. The company does not disclose a specific founding year or ownership structure in its public materials, though it references more than a decade of solar installation experience. The business presents itself as a local contractor offering a range of exterior building services.

The firm provides installation and repair services for roofing, siding, windows, gutters, insulation, and solar energy systems. Its website lists both residential and commercial roofing alongside solar panel installation as core offerings. No facility size, headcount, production volumes, or part numbers are published; the operation appears structured as a service crew model rather than a manufacturing facility.

Customers include homeowners and commercial property owners seeking roof replacement, siding repair, window installation, gutter work, insulation upgrades, and solar array integration. The company’s online project request form explicitly lists residential and commercial categories for each trade, indicating it serves both market segments in the two-state region.

Heartland emphasizes local recognition, an A+ rating, and a 94% recommendation rate from reviewers as differentiators. It highlights "10+ Years of Solar Expertise" and transparent, adjustable pricing on repair jobs. The company does not state a founding mission beyond the general value proposition of energy savings and property improvement through solar and exterior upgrades.
built_on: Transparent pricing adjustments on repair scope changes
type_evidence: The website describes services including 'Residential Roofing, Commercial Roofing, Siding, Windows, Gutters, Solar, Insulation' and features a project request form for 'Repair' or 'Replacement' work, confirming an installation and service business model.
